GPTR-F-001-S61.title: Request Contract Schema Enforcement (Pydantic Models)
GPTR-F-001-S61.description: Define and enforce strict request/response schema using Pydantic models for GPTReader queries (collection, filters, projection, limits) ensuring only valid structures reach enforcement logic.

GPTR-F-001-S62.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S62.description: Implement core validation engine that evaluates incoming GPTReader requests against allowlist rules (collections, fields, operators, limits) and produces deterministic pass/fail decisions.

GPTR-F-001-S63.title: Azure Function Middleware Integration
GPTR-F-001-S63.description: Integrate enforcement engine into Azure Function entrypoint so all GPTReader requests are validated before execution, blocking unauthorized queries at the boundary.

GPTR-F-001-S64.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Enforcement Paths
GPTR-F-001-S64.description: Create comprehensive unit and integration tests covering valid queries, allowlist violations, schema violations, and boundary limits to ensure enforcement correctness and prevent regressions.
